To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the CuInS2 core quantum dots have been prepared in an aqueous solution and that the CuInSe2-Mn dodeoped CdS core-shell quantum dot sensitized TiO(2) solar cells have a power conversion efficiency as high as 5.38%.
we have developed highly efficient core-shell Cu-In-S-Mn doped-Cd-S quantum dot sensitized photovoltaic cells by a simple and cost-effective aqueous solution route.

we have developed a simple aqueous solution synthesis route for mercaptoacetc acid attached CuInSe2 quantum dots and assembled core-shell CuInSe2-Mn doted CdS quantum dot sensitizer solar cells with a power conversion efficiency as high as 5.38%.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a simple and low-cost method for the synthesis of CuInS2 and Mn doped CuInS2 core-shell quantum dots.

the development of a simple and effective route to synthesize mercaptoacctic acid capped CuInS2 and CuInS2-CdS quantum dots, which are used as sensitizers to fabricate highly efficient quantum dot sensitized photovoltaic cells.
the synthesis and characterization of CuInS2 core and Mn doped CdS shell quantum dots and the assembly of CuInS 2-Mn dopped CdS quantum dot-sensitized solar cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the CuInS2 core quantum dots have been successfully sensitized by Mn-doped CdS shell and the core-shell quantum dot sensitized TiO2 film has been assembled into a solar cell with a high power conversion efficiency of over 5%.
CuInS2 is a promising alternative material for quantum dot sensitized photovoltaic devices.
the core-shell structure CuInS2@Mn: CdS QDSSCs are highly efficient and the performance of the devices is comparable with other reported QDSSC devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the core-shell quantum dots are successfully synthesized, and the solar cells based on the core-shell quantum dot sensitizers are fabricated.
a high efficiency solar cell can be fabricated by using the CuInS2 core and Mn doped CdS shell.

the CuInS2 sensitizers have the potential to achieve a power conversion efficiency comparable to that of CdSe quantum dot sensitizers, and the core-shell structure can be used to enhance the efficiency of quantum dot sensitized cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of mercaptoacetyic acid attached CuInSe2 quantum dots as the sensitizers in solar cells can significantly improve the performance compared to those using mercaptopropionic acid attached CuIn(S,Se)2 quantum dots.
CuInS2 is a good alternative to CuInSe2 for the construction of high efficiency quantum dot sensitized cells.
CuInS2 is a promising alternative to the widely studied and commercialized CdTe and CdS quantum dots for quantum dot solar cells, as CuInS2 has a similar band gap and a higher absorption coefficient.
